description: This file defines the SearchFormController class, which manages the display logic for a search form in the SuiteCRM UI, including assigning search query parameters to a Smarty template.

classes.name: SearchFormController
classes.description: Controller for the search form, handling display logic and assigning search parameters to the view.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a SearchQuery object and sets up the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the search form view, passing search query details to the template.
